verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents tools to redact or remove sensitive data retroactively for GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, and lets you control which events are saved. An on-premise option lets organizations manage their own data. However, the evidence never describes configurable retention periods or automated data expiry. Missing for 10: configurable retention windows/auto-expiry, detail on deletion workflows (API or bulk/user-level deletion), independent or hands-on corroboration.
